name: @gjsify/integration-oxfmt-native
description: Integration tests for @gjsify/oxfmt-native — locks in the Node-free `gjsify format` contract end-to-end. Exercises the GI bridge under GJS: hasNativeOxfmt(), the single-shot format(), and the full in-process CLI runOxfmt() (write / check / list-different / `.oxfmtrc.json` honoring via --config). GJS-only because the native bridge needs the Vala/GIR typelib that only loads under SpiderMonkey + GLib.

scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
